files.title: File:Crossing on 522 Av N of 868 Rd - E side.JPG
files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption: Crossing of unnamed stream on county road 522 Avenue between 868 and 869 Roads in Antelope County, Nebraska; east end of culvert.  The stream was formerly crossed by a kingpost pony truss bridge built in 1911, designated NEHBS No. AP00-252, which is listed in the National Register of Historic Places.  No such bridge is now visible in the area.
